# Paths whose change makes a pull request run the `slow` tests too.
# One extended regular expression per line, matched against repo-relative
# paths; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# tests/test_slow_lane.py checks that every slow-marked test file is listed.
^tests/test_active_inference_benchmark\.py$
^kaine/evaluation/benchmarks/active_inference/
^kaine/modules/nous/
^pyproject\.toml$
^\.github/slow-test-paths\.txt$
^\.github/workflows/tests\.yml$
